title: We really enjoyed our...
text: We really enjoyed our private personalized bicycle tour exploring BARCELONA area learning about history, culture, architecture, World's Fair, and Olympic sites and Revitalizations.  His maps and photos were very helpful! Saw a lot and learned a lot while enjoying nature. Highly recommend Jean Pierre!!!!!
author: Roxann_O

title: Amazing Tour!
text: If you want to see ALL of Barcelona in a few hours with a super nice, accommodating and knowledgeable guide, this is the tour for you. Jean Pierre was great and customized the trip to our needs. Highly recommend this tour for anyone especially if you are not spending a lot of time in the city!
author: Edward_J

title: This is a MUST-DO in Barcelona, Jean-Pierre is a GEM!
text: Jean-Pierre is an absolute straight-up FIVE STAR gem!  This is a tour not to miss, I plan to take it again when returning with family and friends and recommend it to EVERYONE of all ages.  There is just so much to see and do in this amazing city, which he brought to live, and it is really best approached by bike.  Much less exhausting than being on our feet all day, which we were the day before at Sagrada Família, and we covered so much ground, too.  No need to be a professional cyclist, either. author: Nokuthula_N

title: Great tour!!!
text:
Great tour with Jean-Pierre, very well-suited to children and adults, and to what we wanted to do based on what we had already seen…. Jean-Pierre is a guide who knows Barcelona by heart and is passionate about its history. 
He tells stories very well and also helps us find our way around the city! 
Highly recommended, it was a pleasure!!!
Lison, Basile and Isabelle
author: I7235DKisabelleh

title: Great bike tour
text: Jean-Pierre was truly amazing for this incredible bike ride in Barcelona. Not only were the landscapes beautiful, but it was thanks to you that we were able to understand the history of each neighborhood, the anecdotes, and the little secrets. It really added a magical depth to our day. Thank you so much.
author: rouxgustave

title: Excellent guide
text: Jean Pierre is an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable. My family were the only people for this tour and he was flexible for minor customizations that we requested. 3 hour tour without getting physically tired for the rest of the day, made it really worthwhile
author: Pankaj_G

title: Best way to see the city!!!
text: Absolutely wonderful tour and history of Barcelona! Jon Pierre is a wealth of knowledge. The bicycling is very low energy and can be enjoyed by all! This is a must!!! Tour busses can’t even begin to show you what this tour offers!
author: Chris_F

title: Take this tour, a fantastic day!
text: Take this tour, it’s a delightful experience! Jean-Pierre is a wealth of knowledge about Barcelona and a patient, joy filled guide. Our group of 4 met him at an easy to find plaza, picked up bikes and saw more sites in a few hours than most would see in several days. Upon request, he even veered off the standard tour to show us the beach. A fantastic finish to our day. Thank you Jean Pierre for taking such pride and joy in sharing your city with us.
author: Wendy_B

title: Jean-Pierre was an...
text: Jean-Pierre was an excellent tour guide. My family enjoyed the bicycle ride very much. It covers quite a bit of places in a short amount of time. Highly recommended.
author: Chausa_C

title: A fabulous tour!
text: What an absolute pleasure! My son and I were the only ones taking the tour on this hot Saturday in July, and we had the most wonderful time. We literally saw all the major sites of Barcelona and zipped through the streets with our guy, Jean Pierre, who is incredibly knowledgeable and kind. I would recommend this trip to anyone who likes to ride bikes and explore cities!
author: Ashley_L
